Package com.csse3200.game.areas.terrain.map

Class MapDataLevelView

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.areas.terrain.map.MapDataLevelView
All Implemented Interfaces:
LevelView
public class MapDataLevelView extends Object implements LevelView
The LevelView over a loaded LevelMapData.

Everything here is derived from the map's collision layer, so features asking about the level never need to know which layer that is or how tile types map to behaviour.
